rdfs:label: theme
rdfs:comment: A main category of a DCAT Dataset — typically a SKOS Concept from a controlled-vocabulary theme list.
notes: Distinct from `urn:solid:keyword` (free-text tags): `dcat:theme` points at structured `urn:solid:Concept`s from a published theme vocabulary. The EU Data Theme vocabulary (`http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/data-theme/`) is the canonical example. The ConceptScheme is declared via `dcat:themeTaxonomy` on the parent Catalog. Applies to any catalogued resource (Catalog, Dataset, DataService). Subject classification only; not a UI or visual theme.

history.note: Dropped rdfs:domain Dataset (applies to any dcat:Resource); noted it is not a UI theme.
